citation.source: Standard physical constants for water at 1 atm (sea-level standard atmospheric pressure) — CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics
citation.note: boilingPointC: 100 is the sea-level value specifically — real water boils below 100°C at altitude. This field itself stays sea-level-only (it's a static citation, not a function of location), but src/altitude.ts (added 2026-08-14, directly answering this note's own long-standing 'unaddressed gap' flag) now computes the REAL altitude-adjusted value on demand: waterBoilingPointC(altitudeMeters), real physics (ICAO Standard Atmosphere barometric formula + water's own Antoine vapor-pressure equation), not a lookup table — cross-checked against real-world figures (Denver 1609m -> ~94.7°C, matching the commonly-cited ~95°C). Composes directly with place.ts's advanceTempSeconds/isAtTargetTemp (scripts/boil-at-altitude.ts) with zero changes to either file. Still NOT closed: EGG_BOIL_DONENESS/POTATO_BOIL_DONENESS's hold-time ranges, and every CCP threshold, still implicitly assume sea-level pressure/timing — this closes the REACH-boiling-temperature half only, named explicitly in altitude.ts's own doc comment, not implied to close the whole gap. specificHeatJPerKgK: 4186 (4.186 J/(g·K)) added 2026-08-13 as the input src/heat-source.ts's estimatedPreheatSeconds needs — a real, essentially constant value across normal cooking temperatures, not a food-composition average like potato.json's/garlic.json's figures.

metadata.notes: isBoilingMedium makes water satisfy BOIL's requiredIngredientCapabilities (data/actions/boil.json), the same pattern as oil.json/isFryingMedium for FRY. isDissolvingMedium (added 2026-08-13) satisfies DISSOLVE's requiredIngredientCapabilities (data/actions/dissolve.json) — a separate flag from isBoilingMedium even though it's the same water, since 'water as what salt dissolves into' and 'water as what something else boils in' are genuinely different culinary roles, matching this codebase's one-capability-per-verb convention (see oil.json's isFryingMedium/isEmulsifier split).
